caption: The drawing depicts a single, empty, pedestal bowl centered on a plain background. The bowl is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a monochromatic appearance. It has a scalloped edge around the wide rim and a fluted body that curves inward toward the short base, which is round and slightly wider at the bottom. Subtle shading is used to suggest the curvature and depth of the object. The background is devoid of any other objects or details, and the paper shows a light beige color with minor signs of age, such as faint spots. In the bottom right corner, the name Bena F. Mayer is printed or signed in uppercase letters.
title: Compote
